title: 飛輪儲能磁軸承系統
titleEn: Flywheel Energy Storage Magnetic Bearing Systems
subcategoryTitle: 機械、壓縮空氣與熱儲能
summary: 飛輪把電能存成轉子的動能：充電時馬達把它加速，放電時它帶動發電機減速。現代的飛輪用碳纖維複合材料做轉子，在真空容器裡以每分鐘上萬轉的速度旋轉，由磁軸承懸浮而不接觸任何東西。美國紐約州的史蒂芬鎮電廠把兩百座飛輪集合成 20 MW，專門替電網調頻。課程定量分析動能與可用能量、輪緣應力與比能量上限、磁軸承的承載、待機損失、扭矩與爆裂能量。
summaryEn: A flywheel stores electricity as kinetic energy of a rotor: a motor speeds it up to charge and it drives a generator as it slows to discharge. Modern flywheels use carbon-fibre composite rotors spinning at over ten thousand revolutions a minute in a vacuum vessel, levitated by magnetic bearings touching nothing. The Stephentown plant in New York State gathers two hundred flywheels into 20 MW for grid frequency regulation. The course quantifies kinetic and usable energy, rim stress and the specific-energy ceiling, magnetic bearing lift, standby loss, torque and burst energy.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與標準架構編寫的原創教學。步驟是可驗證的分析、估算與檢核任務，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、運轉程序或作業許可。核能內容僅限公開的熱循環、功能架構、土木與安全理念，不包含燃料製備、濃縮、再處理、武器、反應度整定、反應爐操作或保安細節。數值為公開標稱值或教學假設，實際工程須由合格專業人員依規範與實測資料重新計算並負責。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and standards frameworks. Steps are verifiable analysis, estimation and checking tasks, not drawings, method statements, operating procedures or permits. Nuclear content is limited to public thermal cycles, functional architecture, civil works and safety concepts and excludes fuel production, enrichment, reprocessing, weapons, reactivity settings, reactor operation and security details. Numbers are public nominal values or teaching assumptions; real work must be recalculated by qualified professionals using codes and measured data.

v30FocusEn: A fast rotor levitated in vacuum: kinetic energy, usable speed range, rim stress, magnetic lift, standby loss and burst energy

stages.title: 資源、需求與系統架構：飛輪儲能磁軸承系統
stages.titleEn: Resource, demand and system architecture: Flywheel Energy Storage Magnetic Bearing Systems
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「飛輪動能」與「電廠的總能量與時長」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Flywheel kinetic energy" and "Total energy and duration of the plant": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

quiz.question: 關於「飛輪動能」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Flywheel kinetic energy" is correct?
options: 飛輪把電能存成轉子的轉動動能，能量與轉動慣量及角速度的平方成正比，所以提高轉速比增加質量有效得多。
飛輪越重儲存的能量越多，轉速不重要。
儲能電廠的功率大，儲存的能量就一定多。
optionsEn: A flywheel stores electricity as rotational kinetic energy of a rotor, proportional to moment of inertia and angular speed squared, so raising speed is far more effective than adding mass.
The heavier the flywheel the more energy it stores; speed does not matter.
A storage plant of high power must hold much energy.
quiz.explanation: 飛輪把電能存成轉子的轉動動能，能量與轉動慣量及角速度的平方成正比，所以提高轉速比增加質量有效得多。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A flywheel stores electricity as rotational kinetic energy of a rotor, proportional to moment of inertia and angular speed squared, so raising speed is far more effective than adding mass. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 飛輪動能：機制與能量路徑
steps.titleEn: Flywheel kinetic energy: mechanism and energy path
steps.objective: 說明「飛輪動能」如何決定「飛輪儲能磁軸承系統」的能量轉換、輸送、儲存或安全功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Flywheel kinetic energy” governs energy conversion, transfer, storage or safety functions in “Flywheel Energy Storage Magnetic Bearing Systems”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 飛輪把電能存成轉子的轉動動能，能量與轉動慣量及角速度的平方成正比，所以提高轉速比增加質量有效得多。現代飛輪以碳纖維複合材料或高強度鋼轉子，在真空腔內由磁軸承支撐，轉速每分鐘上萬轉。它的能量密度不高、自放電較快，但可以在數秒內全功率充放、循環數十萬次而幾乎不衰退，特別適合調頻與電力品質等短時高頻的應用。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A flywheel stores electricity as rotational kinetic energy of a rotor, proportional to moment of inertia and angular speed squared, so raising speed is far more effective than adding mass. Modern flywheels use carbon-fibre composite or high-strength steel rotors on magnetic bearings in a vacuum chamber at tens of thousands of revolutions per minute. Energy density is modest and self-discharge fairly fast, but full-power charge and discharge within seconds and hundreds of thousands of cycles with almost no fade suit short-duration, high-cycle duties such as frequency regulation and power quality. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 工程檔案：電廠由 200 座飛輪組成，總功率 20 MW，2011 年啟用
steps.observationEn: Project file: The plant has 200 flywheels totalling 20 MW, opened in 2011
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「飛輪越重儲存的能量越多，轉速不重要。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在流程圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The heavier the flywheel the more energy it stores; speed does not matter." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your flow diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 流程圖標明「飛輪動能」的輸入、轉換、損失與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The flow diagram shows inputs, conversions, losses and boundary for “Flywheel kinetic energy”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

Modern flywheels use carbon-fibre composite or high-strength steel rotors on magnetic bearings in a vacuum chamber at tens of thousands of revolutions per minute. Energy density is modest and self-discharge fairly fast, but full-power charge and discharge within seconds and hundreds of thousands of cycles with almost no fade suit short-duration, high-cycle duties such as frequency regulation and power quality.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：飛輪越重儲存的能量越多，轉速不重要。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。

quiz.question: 依「飛輪動能」的模型 E = ½·I·ω²，實心圓柱轉子在額定轉速的動能（I = ½·m·r²）最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model E = ½·I·ω² for "Flywheel kinetic energy", which value is closest to the kinetic energy of a solid cylindrical rotor at rated speed (I = ½·m·r²)?
options: 17.6 kWh
35.2 kWh
352 kWh
optionsEn: 17.6 kWh
35.2 kWh
352 kWh
quiz.explanation: E = ½·I·ω²；代入 mf = 1130 kg、rf = 0.4 m、rpm = 16000 rpm，得 35.2 kWh（實心圓柱轉子在額定轉速的動能（I = ½·m·r²））。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: E = ½·I·ω²; with mf = 1130 kg, rf = 0.4 m, rpm = 16000 rpm the result is 35.2 kWh (kinetic energy of a solid cylindrical rotor at rated speed (I = ½·m·r²)). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 飛輪動能：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Flywheel kinetic energy: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「飛輪動能」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Flywheel kinetic energy” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：E = ½·I·ω²；代入 mf = 1130 kg、rf = 0.4 m、rpm = 16000 rpm，得 35.2 kWh（實心圓柱轉子在額定轉速的動能（I = ½·m·r²））。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 rpm 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: E = ½·I·ω²; with mf = 1130 kg, rf = 0.4 m, rpm = 16000 rpm the result is 35.2 kWh (kinetic energy of a solid cylindrical rotor at rated speed (I = ½·m·r²)). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise rpm by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：rpm 增加 10% 時，結果變為 42.6 kWh（+21.0%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising rpm by 10% changes the result to 42.6 kWh (+21.0%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 35.2 kWh（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 rpm 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 35.2 kWh (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in rpm with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: E = ½·I·ω²；代入 mf = 1130 kg、rf = 0.4 m、rpm = 16000 rpm，得 35.2 kWh（實心圓柱轉子在額定轉速的動能（I = ½·m·r²））。
knowledge.textEn: E = ½·I·ω²; with mf = 1130 kg, rf = 0.4 m, rpm = 16000 rpm the result is 35.2 kWh (kinetic energy of a solid cylindrical rotor at rated speed (I = ½·m·r²)).

knowledge.title: 敏感度
knowledge.text: rpm 增加 10% 時，結果變為 42.6 kWh（+21.0%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising rpm by 10% changes the result to 42.6 kWh (+21.0%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為公開標稱值或教學假設的簡化；套用到實際設備前，必須依規範、製造商資料與現場量測重新計算。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are public nominal values or simplified teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, recalculate with codes, manufacturer data and site measurements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「飛輪動能」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Flywheel kinetic energy"?
options: 量測時不必記錄環境溫度、負載與運轉模式，因為它們不影響結果。
磁鐵只能吸住很輕的東西。
以降速試驗（切斷驅動後記錄轉速衰減）量測風損、軸承與電機的待機損失，並以完整充放循環量測往返效率。
optionsEn: Ambient temperature, load and operating mode need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Magnets can only hold very light things.

Measure standby losses from windage, bearings and the electrical machine by a spin-down test, recording speed decay after cutting drive, and measure round-trip efficiency over a full charge-discharge cycle.
quiz.explanation: 以降速試驗（切斷驅動後記錄轉速衰減）量測風損、軸承與電機的待機損失，並以完整充放循環量測往返效率。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure standby losses from windage, bearings and the electrical machine by a spin-down test, recording speed decay after cutting drive, and measure round-trip efficiency over a full charge-discharge cycle. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 飛輪動能：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Flywheel kinetic energy: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「飛輪動能」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Flywheel kinetic energy” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以降速試驗（切斷驅動後記錄轉速衰減）量測風損、軸承與電機的待機損失，並以完整充放循環量測往返效率。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure standby losses from windage, bearings and the electrical machine by a spin-down test, recording speed decay after cutting drive, and measure round-trip efficiency over a full charge-discharge cycle. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：轉子要有超速保護與不平衡監測，圍阻結構須以最大轉速破裂的能量驗證，並把真空與軸承溫度納入連鎖。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Rotors need overspeed protection and unbalance monitoring, containment must be proven for burst energy at maximum speed, and vacuum and bearing temperature belong in the interlocks.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：真空度下降時氣動摩擦發熱使轉子升溫；複合材料轉子若因缺陷而分層破裂，必須由防爆圍阻結構吸收全部動能。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Loss of vacuum heats the rotor by aerodynamic friction, and if a composite rotor delaminates and bursts from a defect, the containment must absorb all its kinetic energy. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以降速試驗（切斷驅動後記錄轉速衰減）量測風損、軸承與電機的待機損失，並以完整充放循環量測往返效率。
knowledge.textEn: Measure standby losses from windage, bearings and the electrical machine by a spin-down test, recording speed decay after cutting drive, and measure round-trip efficiency over a full charge-discharge cycle.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 轉子要有超速保護與不平衡監測，圍阻結構須以最大轉速破裂的能量驗證，並把真空與軸承溫度納入連鎖。
knowledge.textEn: Rotors need overspeed protection and unbalance monitoring, containment must be proven for burst energy at maximum speed, and vacuum and bearing temperature belong in the interlocks.

knowledge.textEn: A public code or guide to compare against: IEC 62933 series on electrical energy storage systems. Confirm edition and applicability before citing it.

quiz.question: 在「飛輪動能」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Flywheel kinetic energy" shows an anomaly, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 真空度下降時氣動摩擦發熱使轉子升溫；複合材料轉子若因缺陷而分層破裂，必須由防爆圍阻結構吸收全部動能。
所有異常都是操作人員失誤，設計、製造與維護不需要檢討。
儲能電廠的功率大，儲存的能量就一定多。
optionsEn: Loss of vacuum heats the rotor by aerodynamic friction, and if a composite rotor delaminates and bursts from a defect, the containment must absorb all its kinetic energy.
Every anomaly is operator error, so design, manufacturing and maintenance never need review.
A storage plant of high power must hold much energy.
quiz.explanation: 真空度下降時氣動摩擦發熱使轉子升溫；複合材料轉子若因缺陷而分層破裂，必須由防爆圍阻結構吸收全部動能。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Loss of vacuum heats the rotor by aerodynamic friction, and if a composite rotor delaminates and bursts from a defect, the containment must absorb all its kinetic energy. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 飛輪動能：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Flywheel kinetic energy: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「飛輪動能」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “Flywheel kinetic energy” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 真空度下降時氣動摩擦發熱使轉子升溫；複合材料轉子若因缺陷而分層破裂，必須由防爆圍阻結構吸收全部動能。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「飛輪儲能磁軸承系統」的安全、出力、壽命或併網。
steps.instructionEn: Loss of vacuum heats the rotor by aerodynamic friction, and if a composite rotor delaminates and bursts from a defect, the containment must absorb all its kinetic energy. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, output, life or grid connection of “Flywheel Energy Storage Magnetic Bearing Systems”.
steps.observation: 連結機制：它的能量密度不高、自放電較快，但可以在數秒內全功率充放、循環數十萬次而幾乎不衰退，特別適合調頻與電力品質等短時高頻的應用。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Energy density is modest and self-discharge fairly fast, but full-power charge and discharge within seconds and hundreds of thousands of cycles with almost no fade suit short-duration, high-cycle duties such as frequency regulation and power quality.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「飛輪越重儲存的能量越多，轉速不重要。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The heavier the flywheel the more energy it stores; speed does not matter." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢查能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 真空度下降時氣動摩擦發熱使轉子升溫；複合材料轉子若因缺陷而分層破裂，必須由防爆圍阻結構吸收全部動能。
knowledge.textEn: Loss of vacuum heats the rotor by aerodynamic friction, and if a composite rotor delaminates and bursts from a defect, the containment must absorb all its kinetic energy.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢查確認；只更換設備、重設警報或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; swapping equipment, resetting alarms or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

knowledge.title: 工程年表
knowledge.text: 2008：1 MW 的示範系統開始為電網調頻
knowledge.textEn: 2008: A 1 MW demonstration began regulating grid frequency

quiz.question: 關於「電廠的總能量與時長」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Total energy and duration of the plant" is correct?
options: 儲能電廠的功率大，儲存的能量就一定多。
飛輪可以一直放電到完全停止。
二十 MW 聽起來是一座不小的電廠，但把兩百座飛輪每座的可用能量加起來，總共只有五 MWh——以滿載輸出只能撐十五分鐘。
optionsEn: A storage plant of high power must hold much energy.
A flywheel can be discharged until it stops completely.
Twenty megawatts sounds a fair-sized plant, but usable energy of two hundred flywheels adds up to only five megawatt-hours, fifteen minutes at full output.
quiz.explanation: 二十 MW 聽起來是一座不小的電廠，但把兩百座飛輪每座的可用能量加起來，總共只有五 MWh——以滿載輸出只能撐十五分鐘。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Twenty megawatts sounds a fair-sized plant, but usable energy of two hundred flywheels adds up to only five megawatt-hours, fifteen minutes at full output. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 電廠的總能量與時長：機制與能量路徑
steps.titleEn: Total energy and duration of the plant: mechanism and energy path
steps.objective: 說明「電廠的總能量與時長」如何決定「飛輪儲能磁軸承系統」的能量轉換、輸送、儲存或安全功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Total energy and duration of the plant” governs energy conversion, transfer, storage or safety functions in “Flywheel Energy Storage Magnetic Bearing Systems”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 二十 MW 聽起來是一座不小的電廠，但把兩百座飛輪每座的可用能量加起來，總共只有五 MWh——以滿載輸出只能撐十五分鐘。這不是缺點，而是定位：它不是用來儲存能量的，而是用來吸收電網每一秒鐘的供需起伏。調度中心每幾秒送來一個指令，要它多輸出一點或多吸收一點；一天之內它要來回充放幾千次，淨輸出的能量卻接近零。這種工作會讓電池很快老化，飛輪卻幾乎不受影響。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Twenty megawatts sounds a fair-sized plant, but usable energy of two hundred flywheels adds up to only five megawatt-hours, fifteen minutes at full output. That is not a flaw but a role: it is not for storing energy but for absorbing the grid's second-by-second swings of supply and demand. Dispatch sends an instruction every few seconds to give a little more or take a little more; in a day it charges and discharges thousands of times with net energy near zero. Such work ages a battery fast and leaves a flywheel almost untouched. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 工程檔案：每座飛輪的額定功率為 100 kW，可持續約 15 分鐘
steps.observationEn: Project file: Each flywheel is rated 100 kW for about 15 minutes
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「儲能電廠的功率大，儲存的能量就一定多。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在流程圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A storage plant of high power must hold much energy." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your flow diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 流程圖標明「電廠的總能量與時長」的輸入、轉換、損失與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The flow diagram shows inputs, conversions, losses and boundary for “Total energy and duration of the plant”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 電廠的總能量與時長
knowledge.titleEn: Total energy and duration of the plant
knowledge.text: 二十 MW 聽起來是一座不小的電廠，但把兩百座飛輪每座的可用能量加起來，總共只有五 MWh——以滿載輸出只能撐十五分鐘。這不是缺點，而是定位：它不是用來儲存能量的，而是用來吸收電網每一秒鐘的供需起伏。調度中心每幾秒送來一個指令，要它多輸出一點或多吸收一點；一天之內它要來回充放幾千次，淨輸出的能量卻接近零。這種工作會讓電池很快老化，飛輪卻幾乎不受影響。
knowledge.textEn: Twenty megawatts sounds a fair-sized plant, but usable energy of two hundred flywheels adds up to only five megawatt-hours, fifteen minutes at full output. That is not a flaw but a role: it is not for storing energy but for absorbing the grid's second-by-second swings of supply and demand. Dispatch sends an instruction every few seconds to give a little more or take a little more; in a day it charges and discharges thousands of times with net energy near zero. Such work ages a battery fast and leaves a flywheel almost untouched.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：儲能電廠的功率大，儲存的能量就一定多。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A storage plant of high power must hold much energy. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 工程檔案
knowledge.text: 每座飛輪的額定功率為 100 kW，可持續約 15 分鐘
knowledge.textEn: Each flywheel is rated 100 kW for about 15 minutes

quiz.question: 依「電廠的總能量與時長」的模型 t = N·e / P，200 座各 25 kWh 的飛輪以 20 MW 輸出時可持續的時間最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model t = N·e / P for "Total energy and duration of the plant", which value is closest to the time 200 flywheels of 25 kWh each can sustain 20 MW?
options: 15 分鐘
150 分鐘
optionsEn: 15 minutes
150 minutes
7.50 minutes
quiz.explanation: t = N·e / P；代入 N = 200、e = 25 kWh、P = 20 MW，得 15 分鐘（200 座各 25 kWh 的飛輪以 20 MW 輸出時可持續的時間）。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: t = N·e / P; with N = 200, e = 25 kWh, P = 20 MW the result is 15 minutes (time 200 flywheels of 25 kWh each can sustain 20 MW). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 電廠的總能量與時長：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Total energy and duration of the plant: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「電廠的總能量與時長」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Total energy and duration of the plant” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：t = N·e / P；代入 N = 200、e = 25 kWh、P = 20 MW，得 15 分鐘（200 座各 25 kWh 的飛輪以 20 MW 輸出時可持續的時間）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 e 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: t = N·e / P; with N = 200, e = 25 kWh, P = 20 MW the result is 15 minutes (time 200 flywheels of 25 kWh each can sustain 20 MW). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise e by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：e 增加 10% 時，結果變為 16 分鐘（+10.0%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising e by 10% changes the result to 16 minutes (+10.0%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 15 分鐘（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 e 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 15 minutes (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in e with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: t = N·e / P；代入 N = 200、e = 25 kWh、P = 20 MW，得 15 分鐘（200 座各 25 kWh 的飛輪以 20 MW 輸出時可持續的時間）。
knowledge.textEn: t = N·e / P; with N = 200, e = 25 kWh, P = 20 MW the result is 15 minutes (time 200 flywheels of 25 kWh each can sustain 20 MW).

knowledge.title: 敏感度
knowledge.text: e 增加 10% 時，結果變為 16 分鐘（+10.0%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising e by 10% changes the result to 16 minutes (+10.0%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為公開標稱值或教學假設的簡化；套用到實際設備前，必須依規範、製造商資料與現場量測重新計算。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are public nominal values or simplified teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, recalculate with codes, manufacturer data and site measurements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「電廠的總能量與時長」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Total energy and duration of the plant"?
options: 沿用另一座電廠或另一台機組的試驗結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
記錄電廠對調頻指令的跟隨精度與反應時間，並統計每天實際的充放電次數與能量吞吐。
飛輪在真空裡沒有摩擦，可以永遠轉下去。
optionsEn: Reusing test results from another plant or unit counts as verifying this project.
Accuracy and speed in following regulation signals are recorded, with real daily cycles and energy throughput compiled.
A flywheel in vacuum has no friction and spins for ever.
quiz.explanation: 記錄電廠對調頻指令的跟隨精度與反應時間，並統計每天實際的充放電次數與能量吞吐。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Accuracy and speed in following regulation signals are recorded, with real daily cycles and energy throughput compiled. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 電廠的總能量與時長：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Total energy and duration of the plant: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「電廠的總能量與時長」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Total energy and duration of the plant” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 記錄電廠對調頻指令的跟隨精度與反應時間，並統計每天實際的充放電次數與能量吞吐。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Accuracy and speed in following regulation signals are recorded, with real daily cycles and energy throughput compiled. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：調頻用的儲能要以功率與循環次數為主要規格，並由調度訊號的設計確保能量維持中性。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Specify regulation storage mainly by power and cycle count, with dispatch signals designed to keep it energy-neutral.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：調頻指令長時間偏向同一個方向時，飛輪被充滿或放空而無法繼續響應，必須由其他資源接手。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: When the regulation signal leans one way for long, flywheels fill or empty and can no longer respond, and other resources must take over. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 記錄電廠對調頻指令的跟隨精度與反應時間，並統計每天實際的充放電次數與能量吞吐。
knowledge.textEn: Accuracy and speed in following regulation signals are recorded, with real daily cycles and energy throughput compiled.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 調頻用的儲能要以功率與循環次數為主要規格，並由調度訊號的設計確保能量維持中性。
knowledge.textEn: Specify regulation storage mainly by power and cycle count, with dispatch signals designed to keep it energy-neutral.

knowledge.title: 規範與標準
knowledge.text: 可對照的公開規範或指引：ASME PTC 53 機械與熱能儲存系統性能試驗。引用時須確認版次與適用範圍。
knowledge.textEn: A public code or guide to compare against: ASME PTC 53 Mechanical and Thermal Energy Storage Systems. Confirm edition and applicability before citing it.

quiz.question: 在「電廠的總能量與時長」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Total energy and duration of the plant" shows an anomaly, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 把警報門檻調寬，就能解決大多數異常。
飛輪可以一直放電到完全停止。
調頻指令長時間偏向同一個方向時，飛輪被充滿或放空而無法繼續響應，必須由其他資源接手。
optionsEn: Widening the alarm thresholds resolves most anomalies.
A flywheel can be discharged until it stops completely.
When the regulation signal leans one way for long, flywheels fill or empty and can no longer respond, and other resources must take over.
quiz.explanation: 調頻指令長時間偏向同一個方向時，飛輪被充滿或放空而無法繼續響應，必須由其他資源接手。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: When the regulation signal leans one way for long, flywheels fill or empty and can no longer respond, and other resources must take over. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 電廠的總能量與時長：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Total energy and duration of the plant: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「電廠的總能量與時長」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “Total energy and duration of the plant” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 調頻指令長時間偏向同一個方向時，飛輪被充滿或放空而無法繼續響應，必須由其他資源接手。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「飛輪儲能磁軸承系統」的安全、出力、壽命或併網。
steps.instructionEn: When the regulation signal leans one way for long, flywheels fill or empty and can no longer respond, and other resources must take over. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, output, life or grid connection of “Flywheel Energy Storage Magnetic Bearing Systems”.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這種工作會讓電池很快老化，飛輪卻幾乎不受影響。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Such work ages a battery fast and leaves a flywheel almost untouched.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「儲能電廠的功率大，儲存的能量就一定多。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A storage plant of high power must hold much energy." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢查能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 調頻指令長時間偏向同一個方向時，飛輪被充滿或放空而無法繼續響應，必須由其他資源接手。
knowledge.textEn: When the regulation signal leans one way for long, flywheels fill or empty and can no longer respond, and other resources must take over.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢查確認；只更換設備、重設警報或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; swapping equipment, resetting alarms or relaxing limits can mask the problem.
